svg.title: A family in the graph: 30 features, 10 groups, six clones, 121 agreed cells
svg.desc: The family code-graph-tools: 30 features in 10 groups, mapped against 6 clones (CodeGraph, codanna, code-review-graph, graphmind, ripwire, srclight). 121 cells have a verdict both readers agreed on: 93 has, 9 partial, 19 none. Edges are the two readers’ agreed verdicts from the mapping gold, not engine output; `export vault` shows the same graph live in Obsidian.
